title: Earth Index — satellite search engine for deforestation/mining opens to public
snippet: Earth Index, a new search engine for satellite imagery, allows users to scan imagery by visual similarity. Users highlight examples (deforestation patches, mining sites) and find comparable patterns elsewhere. Opens to public in April 2026.
